description: This Scala source file defines the AssignmentUtils object, which provides utility methods for aligning and processing update and insert assignments to match table schemas within Apache Spark's SQL Catalyst analysis module. It handles nested column updates, nullability considerations, and schema compatibility checks.

classes.name: AssignmentUtils
classes.description: Utility object providing methods for aligning and validating update and insert assignments to match table schemas, including handling nested fields and nullability.

methods.name: alignUpdateAssignments
methods.description: Aligns update assignments to match table columns, handling nested fields and type coercion.

methods.name: alignInsertAssignments
methods.description: Aligns insert assignments to match table columns, ensuring one-to-one correspondence and default value handling.

methods.name: restoreActualType
methods.description: Restores the actual data type of an attribute, considering metadata.

methods.name: applyAssignments
methods.description: Applies assignment expressions to a column, handling conflicts, nullability, and nested updates.

methods.name: applyFieldAssignments
methods.description: Recursively applies assignments to fields within a struct type.

methods.name: applyNestedFieldAssignments
methods.description: Recursively applies assignments to nested struct fields, handling source field extraction.

methods.name: toNamedStruct
methods.description: Constructs a named struct expression from a struct type and field expressions.

methods.name: hasExtraTargetFields
methods.description: Checks if the target struct type has extra fields not present in the source type.

methods.name: fixNullExpansion
methods.description: Wraps struct assignments with null checks to prevent unnecessary null expansion.

methods.name: aligned
methods.description: Checks if a set of assignments are aligned and compatible with table attributes.
